summary.en: Fill, search, sort, and filter complete records while keeping each roll attached to its score.
summary.bn: পুরো রেকর্ড একসঙ্গে রেখে অ্যারে ভরো, খোঁজো, সাজাও আর দরকারি রেকর্ড বেছে নাও।

notes: These complete programs target C17; declarations in loops require C99 or later.

examples.title: Find one roll in the register
examples.explanationHtml: Roll two is found at index one with score ninety.

examples.title: Rank by score with whole-record swaps

practice.title: Total an entered register
practice.statementHtml: Read count from 0 to 10, then count roll-score pairs. Rolls are 1 to 999 and scores 0 to 100. Print Count and roll-score pairs: then total score.
hints: Only entries below count are initialized records.

practice.title: Search a register by roll
practice.statementHtml: Read count and records with the previous register bounds, then a target roll from 1 to 999. Print Count and roll-score pairs: and Target roll: on separate lines. Print the first matching score or missing.
hints: Keep -1 for an absent match and test it before indexing.

practice.title: Order records by roll
practice.statementHtml: Read count from 0 to 10 and valid roll-score pairs. Print Count and roll-score pairs: then one roll score pair per line in ascending roll order. Preserve equal-roll order.
hints: Swap complete records only when the left roll is larger.

practice.title: Keep passing records in order
practice.statementHtml: Read count from 0 to 10 and valid roll-score pairs. Print Count and roll-score pairs:, then Passed: followed by the number with score at least 40. Print those pairs in original order.
hints: Use separate read and write indices for in-place compaction.

quiz.prompt: Which expression selects score in the third Mark record?
quiz.explanation: Index two selects the third structure, then dot selects its member.

quiz.prompt: What must a record sorting swap move?
quiz.explanation: Related fields must remain associated during sorting.

quiz.prompt: What does index -1 mean in the linear register search?
quiz.explanation: Test the sentinel before using an array index.

quiz.prompt: Which condition preserves equal-score order in a descending adjacent sort?
quiz.explanation: A strict comparison leaves equal keys in their original relative order.

quiz.prompt: What is the worst-case time of the adjacent-swap register sort?
quiz.explanation: Nested passes can compare roughly n*(n-1)/2 neighboring pairs.

quiz.prompt: What count controls valid reads from a partly filled record array?
quiz.explanation: Unused capacity may contain no initialized record values.

quiz.prompt: Why does in-place filtering keep write no greater than read?
quiz.explanation: Accepted records are copied to earlier or current slots.

quiz.prompt: What score total is computed from the three complete records?
quiz.explanation: Only the three scores are added.

quiz.prompt: Which roll-score pair belongs to the first matching roll two?
quiz.explanation: The matched record at index one contains roll two and score ninety.

quiz.prompt: Which order results from the stable descending score sort?
quiz.explanation: Whole records move, and equal-score rolls four and eight keep their order.

keyPoints.en: Each array element can be a complete record.
keyPoints.bn: অ্যারের প্রতিটি এলিমেন্টে একটি পুরো রেকর্ড রাখা যায়।

keyPoints.en: Use an index and then a dot to select a record member.
keyPoints.bn: রেকর্ডের মেম্বার নিতে আগে ইনডেক্স, তারপর ডট ব্যবহার করো।

keyPoints.en: Sorting must move related fields together.
keyPoints.bn: সাজানোর সময় একই রেকর্ডের মেম্বারগুলো একসঙ্গে সরাও।

keyPoints.en: A missing search result must be checked before indexing.
keyPoints.bn: খোঁজার ফল পাওয়া গেছে কি না দেখে তারপর ইনডেক্স ব্যবহার করো।

keyPoints.en: Logical record count can be smaller than array capacity.
keyPoints.bn: আসল রেকর্ডের সংখ্যা অ্যারের ক্যাপাসিটির চেয়ে কম হতে পারে।

examQuestions.question: Why is sorting only score members wrong for student records?
examQuestions.answerHtml: Each score belongs to the roll in its record. Moving scores alone changes those associations. Compare score fields for ordering, but swap complete structure elements so every roll retains its own score.

examQuestions.question: Explain stable filtering of passing records with two indices.
examQuestions.answerHtml: Scan records using read. When score is at least 40, copy the complete record to marks[write] and increment write. Since write never exceeds read, no unread record is overwritten. Accepted records retain input order. At the end, write is the new logical count.

2 90
4 70
8 70

Roll two leads with ninety; tied rolls four and eight preserve their input order.
